testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.patchloop.service.ExecutionPauseServiceTest

testcase.name: setPaused with true overwrites existing pause state
setPaused adds execution to paused state
getPausedCount returns zero when no executions paused
clearPaused is idempotent for non-existent execution
setPaused with false removes execution from paused state
getPausedCount returns correct count for multiple paused executions
isPaused returns false for non-existent execution
clearPaused removes execution from paused state
